ruleset.name: RSS-Bridge PHPCompatibility
ruleset.description:
Optional PHP cross-version compatibility check for RSS-Bridge (PHP 8.5+).
Coverage for the newest PHP releases is incremental; treat findings as advisory. The authoritative PHP 8.5 gate remains composer's platform requirement plus PHPStan (phpstan.neon) and PHPCS (phpcs.xml). If this check is not wanted, delete this file instead.
